reconstructed.baseline: Pod template from the catalog target and the run's pinned image digest; the recorded baseline id is kept, its template hash is not recoverable
reconstructed.dependency_finding: held at CLEAR for every case, like the fixture approval
reconstructed.derived: planning and live state set to the baseline template; incident signals kept
reconstructed.observations: one Observer snapshot rebuilt from the incident's quoted signals
reconstructed.planning_state: baseline template with the catalog fault applied, recorded resource versions and generation, not-ready status
